note: Short clips (16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAV) cut from one recorded talking-head source. Times in 'events' and 'words' are REBASED to the clip: clip_t = source_t - source_start. The source itself is not committed; tests skip when a clip is missing.
source_floor_note: talkinghead.audio.noise_floor (25th percentile of the 5 ms dBFS envelope) over the whole source. On a 6-20 s clip the same percentile is NOT a noise floor: it lands on speech in speech-dense clips (-43.5 dBFS on word-boundary-216.0) and on dead air in silence-heavy ones (-68.8 dBFS on outro-1882.0). Tests that snap word bounds pass this source floor explicitly.
source_vad_note: detect_silences over the whole source: 15th-percentile 20 ms RMS floor 33.5 (-59.8 dBFS), speech threshold 2x = -53.8 dBFS. A clip-local run has its own threshold (e.g. -50.5 dBFS on voiced-gap-253.0), so clip-local silences can appear where the full-file run found none; the per-event 'silences_inside' are the full-file result.
cut_command: ffmpeg -y -v error -ss START -to END -i SRC -vn -ar 16000 -ac 1 -c:a pcm_s16le -f wav -fflags +bitexact -flags:a +bitexact OUT
